BC_description: Direct imports of internal Redux modules (such as 'redux/lib/createStore', 'redux/es/createStore', or any file under 'redux/lib/*' and 'redux/es/*') are no longer supported due to changes in the module bundling approach introduced in v4.0.0. Going forward, only imports from the main public entry point 'redux' are allowed. This means any downstream code that relies on internal module paths (for example, importing functions or classes from 'redux/lib/*' or 'redux/es/*') will break, regardless of whether CommonJS or ES module syntax is used. All public APIs—including 'createStore', 'combineReducers', etc.—must now be imported exclusively from the package entry ('redux'). This change was made to improve bundle size, consistency, and user experience by producing a single, optimized output file for each format, and aligning the build process with modern best practices. Downstream clients must update imports to ensure compatibility with Redux v4.0.0 and later.
